name: HRM_PLAN_HISTORY
description: Plan history table stores the history records of the plan. It contains history data with old and new values.

columns.name: PLAN_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Plan history id uniquely represents the plan history row.

columns.name: PLAN_ID
columns.description: Plan id represents the primary key for plan.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise id represents enterprise id for the plan.

columns.name: MODIFIED_DATE
columns.description: modified date represents the date on which this change is committed.

columns.name: MODIFIED_BY
columns.description: modified by represents the person id who made this change.

columns.name: MODIFIED_COLUMN
columns.description: Modified column represents the name of modified column.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE
columns.description: Old value represents the old value of what changed attribute.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: New value represents the new value of what changed attribute.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.description: Operation type represents the type of operation committed.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
